forward_sam._doc: Low-confidence / future-dated demand (e.g. Saudi-Red Sea 2030 destination caps). Computed at MID but held OUT of the near-term grounded floor and estimated_total; reported as forward-looking SAM only.

roadmap_quanta_lr_2026plus.note: Beyond Pioneer II 70nm range; need Quanta-LR (H2 2026+, capacity/capex not locked). Economics held out of near-term number per null-beats-guess.
